author: Ben
description: Secure cryptographic operations module written in Go and compiled to WebAssembly. Provides comprehensive cryptographic functions with GoWM integration.

errorHandling.description: Crypto module returns objects with 'error' field when operations fail
errorHandling.detection: if (result.error) { /* handle error */ } else { /* use result data */ }

examples.cause: Called encryptAES() with malformed base64 key
examples.error: Invalid key format: illegal base64 data at input byte 7

examples.cause: Called generateAESKey() when random number generator is unavailable
examples.error: Failed to generate key: insufficient entropy

examples.cause: Called verifyJWT() with invalid signature or wrong secret
examples.error: JWT verification failed: signature is invalid
RSA key generation failed: key size too small

examples.title: GoWM Integration - Basic Hashing
AES Encryption/Decryption
Crypto Toolkit Integration
Error Handling Patterns

functions.description: Generate SHA256 hash of input data
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: hashSHA256

functions.description: Generate SHA512 hash of input data
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = crypto.call('hashSHA512', 'Hello World');
// Returns: { hash: '...', algorithm: 'SHA512' }
functions.name: hashSHA512

functions.description: Generate MD5 hash (legacy support only - not secure)
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.example:
const result = crypto.call('hashMD5', 'Hello World');
// Includes security warning in response
functions.name: hashMD5

functions.description: Generate a random AES encryption key
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: generateAESKey

functions.description: Encrypt data using AES-GCM (authenticated encryption)
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure (e.g., invalid key format)
functions.name: encryptAES

functions.description: Decrypt data using AES-GCM
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: decryptAES

functions.description: Generate RSA public/private key pair
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: generateRSAKeyPair

functions.description: Encrypt data using RSA public key
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: encryptRSA

parameters.description: Data to encrypt (limited by key size)
parameters.name: data

functions.description: Decrypt data using RSA private key
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: decryptRSA

functions.description: Generate a JWT token with HMAC-SHA256 signature
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: generateJWT

parameters.description: JSON string of claims to include
parameters.name: payload

functions.description: Verify and decode a JWT token
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: verifyJWT

functions.description: Hash password using bcrypt with salt
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: bcryptHash

functions.description: Verify password against bcrypt hash
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: bcryptVerify

functions.description: Generate a random UUID v4
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: generateUUID

functions.description: Generate cryptographically secure random bytes
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: generateRandomBytes

parameters.description: Number of random bytes to generate
parameters.name: length

functions.description: Encode data to base64
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: base64Encode

functions.description: Decode base64 data
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: base64Decode

functions.description: Validate password strength and provide feedback
functions.errorPattern: Returns object with 'error' field on failure
functions.name: validatePasswordStrength

functions.description: Enable/disable silent mode for console logs
functions.example: crypto.call('setSilentMode', true); // returns true and enables silent mode
functions.name: setSilentMode

parameters.description: true to enable silent mode, false to disable it
parameters.name: silent

functions.description: Get list of all available functions in the module
functions.example:
const functions = crypto.call('getAvailableFunctions');
console.log('Available functions:', functions);
functions.name: getAvailableFunctions

name: crypto-wasm

types.description: Standard result type for crypto operations
types.details: Returns object with data on success, or object with 'error' field on failure
types.name: CryptoResult
